text: Potholes on the main road are causing severe traffic congestion and damage to cars. Please repair the road.
The main avenue has a massive sinkhole that could cause a major accident. It is extremely dangerous.
The pavement on 5th street has cracked completely and elderly people are tripping. Needs urgent repair.
Road construction has been abandoned halfway, blocking the entrance to our residential complex.
Frequent power outages in our locality. The electricity goes off every 2 hours without any warning.
Live high-voltage wire is dangling from the electric pole on the main street. This is a life hazard!
The transformer in our area is sparking continuously and making loud noises. We fear it might explode.
Electricity bill is incorrectly calculated. It is showing a massive amount that does not match my meter readings.
Streetlights are not working in our lane. It is pitch dark at night, making it unsafe for women and children.
All the street lights on the highway patch near exit 4 are broken. Driving at night is very risky.
The street light in front of house 42B is blinking constantly, causing irritation to residents.
There is no drinking water supply in our apartment complex for the past 3 days. We have to buy private tankers.
A major water pipe leak has occurred on the main road, wasting thousands of liters of clean water.
The municipal water supplied to our house is muddy and has a strong chemical smell. It is contaminated.
Garbage has not been collected from our bins for over a week. The pile is rotting and attracting flies.
People are dumping plastic waste and construction debris in the local park, turning it into a dump yard.
The garbage collection truck did not come today. I am happy with the usual service but today was missed.
Public toilets near the market are extremely dirty, unhygienic, and emit a terrible foul smell.
The open drainage pipe is blocked and dirty black sewage water is overflowing onto the walking path.
Rainwater is flooding the entire road because the storm water drains are clogged with plastic bags and dirt.
The gutter cover in front of the grocery shop is broken, leaving a deep open hole on the busy footpath.
Road quality is excellent after the recent tarring. Thanks to the municipal corporation for the swift work.
Very satisfied with the quick restoration of power after the storm. The line workers did a great job.
Water leakage in the pipeline was fixed quickly. Good service by the plumbing department.
The school building has cracked walls that pose a risk to students. Please inspect it.
Stray dog menace is increasing in our sector. They are chasing children playing in the evenings.
Illegal parking in the residential zone is causing daily arguments and blocking paths.
